title: A VARCHAR against a number is cast to the number, and raises on a string that is not one
verdict: a string compared with an integer is cast to the integer (leading blanks and zeros accepted); a non-number raises; sverify refuses the comparison
description: `s = i` with `s = '01'` or `' 1'` and `i = 1` is true, and `s IN (1)` as well: the string is cast to the integer. A string that is not a number raises: `'abc' = 1` is `Could not convert string 'abc' to INT32`. `||` casts a number to text (`'01' || 1` is `'011'`), `UNION ALL` of an integer and a string is a VARCHAR column, and `CASE` mixing them is a binder error (`an explicit cast is required`).
reference: Sverify refuses each of these: the lift says `equal of string, int32 is not supported`, `IN of string, int32, int32`, `CASE of int32, string`, `UNION of int32, string`, `|| of a int32`, `add of string and int32`. No plan carries the coercion.
